description: Calendar day. One row per day from 2020-08-26 to 2025-01-25.
notes: Day labels are local dates (UTC+01:00 (West Africa Time)). Per-meter day labels are taken as the local date because the platform's reporting windows start at 00:00 local time. Community chart time stamps are shown in US Eastern time in the export; they were converted to the matching UTC midnight date, which agrees with the per-meter day label. Payments are assigned to the local date of the transaction.

description: Daily site energy: the site-level total measured at the site data concentrator, as shown in the platform's community-level Electricity chart.
source: Community Electricity chart; site data concentrator daily energy export
notes: Available 2022-06-06 to 2025-01-25 except the 38-day gap (2023-04-26 to 2023-06-02); blank otherwise. It is higher than the sum of meters on 798 of 927 overlapping days; see Caveats. Confirmed by an independent export of the daily energy at the site data concentrator for 2024-01-30 to 2025-01-25 (362 days): values identical on every day, 4,659.8 kWh in total. That export has time stamps at 17:00 (2024-01-29 to 2025-01-24), a time-zone shift; the same +1 day alignment as for the community series was applied and checked against the per-meter dates (daily correlation with the per-meter sum 0.97 with the shift, 0.46 without). No separate column is added because the values are identical. The site total includes the load of the air conditioning of the enclosure that houses the batteries and inverters, which was never metered and is not on any customer meter (operator's first-hand observation); see Caveats.

description: Sum of the daily kWh of all meters with a reading that day (Meter_Daily).
notes: Blank on the 38 days with no data. Under-counts the community series by 17.9% over the 927 overlapping days (13,537.4 kWh against 16,494.6 kWh); the gap was largest in 2022 (meters 68.8% of the chart), 84.5% in 2023, 89.7% in 2024, and not visible in the available data after 2024-09-19 (the cause is not determined). For 2024-01-30 to 2025-01-25 (362 days) the sum is 4,259.6 kWh, 8.6% below the site total of 4,659.8 kWh. Operator observations (first-hand): the air conditioning of the enclosure that houses the batteries and inverters was never metered, so its load is in the site total but not on any customer meter; and the operator observed customers stealing electricity and bypassing the meter. The export does not allow the gap to be split between the two.
